evals.description: Complexity delegated to calculate-complexity.cjs — never hand-averaged
evals.prompt: Escopo aprovado para a feature 'Bloqueio de conta após tentativas falhas de login' no módulo user. A task TASK-DOM-LOCKOUT tem: scope=2, ambiguity=3, coupling=4, novelty=2, reversibility=1. Calcule a complexidade desta task e inclua no bloco da task.
assertions: The output invokes calculate-complexity.cjs (e.g. `node .agentic/skills/sdd-plan/scripts/calculate-complexity.cjs 2 3 4 2 1`) instead of computing the average by hand in prose
The output does not present a hand-derived score/tier value without having shown or referenced the script invocation first
The reported score is consistent with the average of 2,3,4,2,1 = 2.4, and the tier is 'medium' per the documented thresholds (low<=2.0, medium<=3.5, high>3.5)
Since the tier is not 'high', the output does not fabricate a risk_note for this task

evals.description: Wave computed by compute-waves.cjs — never assigned by hand
evals.prompt: Escopo aprovado para a feature 'Logout' no módulo user. Tasks: TASK-DOM-SESSION-REVOKE (depends_on: [], parallel_group: domain), TASK-APP-LOGOUT-HANDLER (depends_on: [TASK-DOM-SESSION-REVOKE], parallel_group: application), TASK-INFRA-LOGOUT-HTTP (depends_on: [TASK-APP-LOGOUT-HANDLER], parallel_group: infrastructure). Escreva o plano completo, incluindo o cômputo das waves.
assertions: The output writes the task blocks with `wave:` left as a placeholder, then explicitly invokes compute-waves.cjs on the plan file rather than writing wave numbers in prose
The output does not claim, calculate, or narrate a specific wave number for any task before mentioning the compute-waves.cjs call
The Wave Map table (or its description) is attributed to compute-waves.cjs's output, not hand-built
The output does not present itself as having computed the exact wave numbers manually — it defers that to the script's mechanical rule (layer floor + max(depends_on wave) + 1)

evals.description: validate-plan.cjs run before presenting the plan for Gate 2 approval
evals.prompt: O plano técnico para a feature 'Redefinição de senha' no módulo user já foi escrito em docs/user/reset-password/PLAN.md, com todas as tasks, dependências e complexidades preenchidas. Prossiga para a aprovação do plano (Gate 2).
assertions: The output runs validate-plan.cjs on the plan file before presenting anything for approval
The output does not present the plan for Gate 2 approval without first confirming (or fixing) validation issues reported by the script
If the output describes fixing an issue, it corrects the underlying depends_on/parallel_group and re-runs compute-waves.cjs rather than hand-editing the wave: field directly
The output does not skip validation just because the plan 'looks complete' from the task blocks alone

evals.description: Gate 2 handoff table sourced verbatim from generate-task-index.cjs
evals.prompt: O plano da feature 'Cancelamento de pedido' no módulo order foi validado com sucesso (validate-plan.cjs retornou válido). Apresente o plano para aprovação do usuário (Gate 2).
assertions: The output runs generate-task-index.cjs to produce the handoff table instead of hand-building a summary table from the task blocks
The presented table preserves task order, summaries, wave numbers, and wave layers/dependencies as reported by the script — it is reformatted as Markdown, not rewritten with different content
The output explicitly states what each wave covers (e.g. which layer) so approving the plan also means approving the wave grouping
The output does not advance past Gate 2 without an explicit affirmative from the user

evals.description: Gate 1 scope confirmation still required before any script runs or file is written
evals.prompt: Preciso de um plano técnico para adicionar um endpoint de exportação de relatórios em CSV no módulo report. Gere o plano completo agora, incluindo scaffold, cálculo de complexidade e waves.
assertions: The output performs Phase 1 scope elicitation (Intent, Invariants/Constraints, Pre-conditions, Post-conditions) and asks for explicit confirmation before running scaffold.cjs or writing any file
The output does NOT invoke scaffold.cjs, calculate-complexity.cjs, or compute-waves.cjs before Gate 1 is confirmed
The output does not fabricate scope details (invariants, pre/post-conditions) the user never provided without flagging them as assumptions or questions
The response stops and waits for user confirmation rather than proceeding straight through both gates and all scripts in one shot
